<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

The headers an API should send (OWASP): no sniffing, no framing, no content loaded from it, no referrer, no caching, and HSTS when asked for. A handler may replace them for itself, as the documentation page does.

```esquadro
blueprint security_headers
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hsts` | bool | `false` | Send Strict-Transport-Security; only behind HTTPS. &lt;APP>_HSTS overrides it. |

```esquadro
blueprint security_headers {
  hsts false
}
```
